questions.question: When comparing LangChain LCEL, LangGraph, CrewAI, and DSPy, which paradigm is explicitly designed for cyclic agent state graphs with conditional branching?
questions.explanation: LangGraph extends LCEL to model multi-actor, cyclic state machines with explicit graph nodes, edges, and state persistence.

questions.question: What is the core philosophy of DSPy compared to traditional manual prompt engineering?
options: A) DSPy replaces LLMs with decision trees.
B) DSPy compiles declarative modules and automatically optimizes prompts/few-shot examples using telemetry metrics.
C) DSPy requires writing longer system prompts manually.
D) DSPy is strictly limited to single-turn chat completion.
questions.explanation: DSPy abstracts away string prompting by letting developers program declaratively with modules and optimize prompts algorithmically via teleprompters/optimizers.
